title: Midnight in Bonetown
globalRules: Every elapsed in-world day reduces Gebert's remaining rescue window; at zero he is unrecoverable alive.
Bonetown skeletons are sapient residents; corrupted skeletons are a separate hostile category.
Rixi hostility is directed primarily at skeletons/corrupted skeletons and is not automatic hostility to living PCs.
Off-path travel between forest locations is allowed at approximately triple travel time and three Forest Die rolls.
Spore hallucinations are perceptions, not persistent facts.
Resurrection Stones cause corruption and are produced by Dim.
The Red Dragon, Water Elemental, Balstrava and Mycelicardia are independent actors, not mandatory boss encounters.
The Gebert objective can resolve without solving every cavern threat.

clocks.advanceRule: Advance one segment per elapsed in-world day. At 21, Gebert cannot be rescued alive.
Harming infected creatures in the forest worsens the next forest danger according to source procedure.

scenes.title: The Alley at Midnight
requiredFacts: The cavern entrance appears magically at midnight in a dank alley.
A steep dark descent leads toward Bonetown.

choices.label: Inspect the magical arch before entering

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Allow investigation or refusal. Time spent outside can consume Gebert's deadline.

scenes.title: Welcome to Bonetown
requiredFacts: Bonetown is a functioning community of roughly 100 resurrected skeletons.
Gebert is missing and reward notices are widespread.
hiddenFacts: Some skeletons are beginning to show fungal corruption.

choices.label: Ask about Gebert and the reward
Visit the tavern and listen for rumours
Study the town and its skeleton residents

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Treat skeleton residents as ordinary sapient NPCs unless an individual state says corrupted/hostile.

scenes.title: Find the Wizard
requiredFacts: Gebert left one week ago seeking Resurrection Stones and failed to return.
Bonetown offers major rewards for his return, Stone-source information or Stones.
hiddenFacts: Gebert is inside a Dim in the Warrens.

choices.label: Ask what happened to previous search parties
Ask what is known about Resurrection Stones
Ask who knows the forest best

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Bonetown knows Gebert is missing but not the exact Dim containing him or the full Stone source.

scenes.title: Drinks, Bones and Rumours
requiredFacts: The tavern, musicians and generated skeleton residents provide rumours about the forest, Rixi, Stones and missing scouts.

choices.label: Talk with Tiana or the musicians

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Generated rumours stay tagged as rumours until independently verified.

scenes.title: The Bonetown Strip
requiredFacts: Armory, flea market, alchemist and racetrack are available.
hiddenFacts: Albert is becoming corrupted and hoarding weapons.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use source prices/items/procedures via Cairn item layer. Albert's secret requires observation or pressure; don't announce it automatically.

scenes.title: Fungus on the Bones
requiredFacts: Some skeletons show early fungal growth and try to hide/remove it.
Fully corrupted skeletons have historically become violent and been expelled.
hiddenFacts: Albert is one current high-risk example.

choices.label: Examine or ask about the Resurrection Stones
Leave the problem for now and search for Gebert

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Corruption is gradual and individual. Don't trigger a town-wide uprising without earned state changes.

scenes.title: Into the Fungal Forest
requiredFacts: Travel between directly connected points takes about an hour; off-path routes are possible at triple time and risk.
Forest Die procedures govern danger.
hiddenFacts: Mycelicardia senses harm to infected creatures through the network.

choices.label: Travel toward the southern Rixi village
Search for useful fungi while travelling
Cut off the marked paths toward another known location

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Resolve travel with Forest Die. Any known location may be attempted off-path at 3x time and 3 rolls.

scenes.title: Leave the Trails
requiredFacts: Off-path forest travel is allowed but takes roughly three times as long and three Forest Die rolls.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Ask destination only if player did not name one. Advance time and resolve all three Forest Die events.

scenes.title: Gathering Dangerous Ingredients
requiredFacts: Fungi have magical types and trade values used by Duli and the Rixi.

choices.label: Search cautiously for whatever fungi you find
Risk a targeted search for a specific magical type
Use the mushrooms as Rixi trade currency

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use source fungus table/type/MV and hunting procedure.

scenes.title: The Electric Railroad
requiredFacts: The railroad provides fast travel with no normal Forest Die along its path if ridden successfully.

choices.label: Use the line toward the southern village

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Stowaway/arrest consequences apply at Rixi villages if caught.

scenes.title: Cross the Electric River
requiredFacts: Rocks form a difficult ford through eel-filled electrified water.
Cave Ducks swim here safely.
hiddenFacts: Cave Ducks know useful information about Dim.

choices.label: Try to communicate with the Cave Ducks

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Falling means eel danger; creative bridging/insulation plans are valid.

scenes.title: Quacks About Worms
requiredFacts: Cave Ducks are enemies of Dim and can provide information if PCs can communicate with them.

choices.label: Ask how they navigate in darkness

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Communication requires Duckspeaker, magic or plausible character ability. Ducks know Dim ecology, not every cavern secret.

scenes.title: Rixi Village South
requiredFacts: Village is fortified/electrified and will consider admitting outsiders who help against corrupted skeletons.

choices.label: Ask about Gebert and the Warrens
Take the train to the north village

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Skeleton PCs face serious Rixi hostility and need exceptional diplomacy/context; living outsiders are not automatically attacked.

scenes.title: Rixi Village North Under Attack
requiredFacts: The village is under attack by corrupted skeletons riding Sporespiders when first encountered.

choices.label: Avoid the fight and continue past
Try to interfere without siding with the Rixi
Watch the fight to understand both sides

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Resolve battle according to Cairn and faction state. If PCs ignore it, do not reset the attack forever; establish aftermath.

scenes.title: Gaspar and the Delver
requiredFacts: Gaspar is the Rixi mechanic who can repair the Delver at a Warrens entrance.

choices.label: Ask Gaspar to help with the Delver
Recruit Rixi guides for the Warrens

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Rixi gratitude depends on previous actions; free support is strongest if PCs defended the village.

scenes.title: The Bound Ferryman
requiredFacts: A Shroom Troll is magically bound to operate the ferry and wants someone else to take her place.
hiddenFacts: Taking over the chain/service can transfer the binding.

choices.label: Ask why the troll is chained to the ferry
Try to break the magical binding
Find another way across without the ferry
Agree to take the troll's place

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: The troll may deceive PCs, but the AI cannot conceal obvious facts if they investigate. Binding transfer has real consequences.

scenes.title: The Voice in the Well
requiredFacts: A Water Elemental trapped by Balstrava is at the bottom.

choices.label: Try to collect water from the well

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Elemental behaviour remains autonomous. Freed does not equal recruited.

scenes.title: The Resurrection Vision
requiredFacts: Blood-stained stones show a disturbing resurrection vision when closely inspected.
hiddenFacts: Vision reinforces that Stone resurrection has dangerous consequences.

choices.label: Examine the old blood and stonework without touching it
Experiment with a Resurrection Stone here

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Vision is a source event; don't add new prophecies or make it objectively rewrite history.

scenes.title: The Dragon Under the Water
requiredFacts: A Red Dragon is trapped below, protected by Sporemanders and willing to bargain for escape.
It wants to burn the fungal forest/Mycelicardia.
hiddenFacts: A Dim may be able to enlarge its exit; the dragon can command nearby Dim.

choices.label: Attack the dragon or its guardians
Ask what it knows about the fungal network

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Treat dragon as intelligent independent actor. It may bargain; its freedom has real consequences.

scenes.title: Fire Against Fungus
requiredFacts: Dragon can offer its hoard for credible escape and views the Mycelicardia as enemy.

choices.label: Agree to help use a Dim to free it
Pretend to agree while planning to take the hoard

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Dragon evaluates plans intelligently. It is not obligated to hand over treasure before credible progress.

scenes.title: Into the Dim Warrens
requiredFacts: The Warrens have multiple entrances and a procedural exploration system.
Dim produce Resurrection Stones and Gebert is trapped inside one.
hiddenFacts: A successful Dim encounter roll can reveal Gebert by muffled cries.

choices.label: Repair/use the Delver at the cave-in

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: No single entrance is mandatory. Use Warrens Die and room/encounter state.

scenes.title: Worm Tunnels
requiredFacts: Dim movement can swallow obstructing creatures; side tunnels/chambers provide refuge.
Resurrection Stones can be found behind/around Dim.
hiddenFacts: Gebert may be inside a generated Dim.

choices.label: Prioritise finding a Dim carrying Gebert

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Roll/use source Warrens procedure. `Search Gebert` increases focus but does not guarantee immediate discovery unless procedure/evidence supports it.

scenes.title: Muffled Screams
requiredFacts: A Dim carries Gebert inside and he can be heard if the correct encounter occurs.

choices.label: Kill the Dim and cut Gebert free
Lure/control the Dim to a safer place first
Use the Red Dragon's influence over Dim if available
Use the Delver or tools to create an extraction opportunity
Mark the worm and retreat to prepare

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Rescue requires physically plausible action and Cairn resolution. Failure can injure/lose Gebert without magically resetting him into another worm.

scenes.title: Bring Gebert Home
requiredFacts: Gebert is alive and rescued if extraction succeeded before deadline.

choices.label: Ask Gebert what he learned about Resurrection Stones

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Rescue resolves primary reward but doesn't force campaign end.

scenes.title: The Nesting Chamber
requiredFacts: Multiple Dim rest on eggs; many Stones lie between nests.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Dim protect eggs but are not automatically aggressive if nest remains unthreatened.

scenes.title: The Tomb the Worms Broke
requiredFacts: Dim tunnelling breached an older tomb containing magic items.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use source item mechanics from item layer.

scenes.title: Where the Stones Come From
requiredFacts: The communal Dim waste area contains thousands of Resurrection Stones.

choices.label: Take enough Stones to prove the source
Attempt to haul a large quantity away
Study why the Dim produce them
Try to destroy the Stone stockpile

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Thousands of Stones create logistics, corruption and economic consequences; do not auto-add them all to inventory.

scenes.title: Time Above
requiredFacts: Gebert's rescue clock continues while PCs are away.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Advance elapsed days honestly; at deadline set Gebert unrecoverable.

endings.title: The Wizard Comes Home
endings.summary: Gebert returns alive before the digestion deadline. Bonetown pays its rescue reward; corruption, Rixi tension and the fungal ecosystem remain available campaign threads.

endings.title: The Source of Resurrection
endings.summary: The party proves that Dim produce Resurrection Stones and can claim the source-information/recovered-Stone rewards even if Gebert is dead or unrecoverable.

endings.title: Too Late
endings.summary: The 21-day rescue window expires. Gebert is fully digested. The party may still solve the Stone mystery and continue exploring the cavern.

endings.title: A New Ferryman
endings.summary: A character inherits the Waterfall ferry's magical obligation if they truly accept/trigger the binding. This is a character-state ending/complication, not necessarily campaign termination.

endings.title: Bonetown Without You
endings.summary: The party leaves the crisis unresolved. Gebert's deadline, corruption and cavern faction/ecology states continue off-screen for future return.

endings.title: The Cavern Remains
endings.summary: Any primary objective can end while Bonetown and the cavern remain a reusable adventure site for trade, faction play, alchemy, Stones and the Mycelicardia threat.
